name: campaign-review
title: Campaign review pack
for_each: select id,name from campaigns order by name

sections.title: Audience record review
sections.sql: select p.name,p.company,p.score,p.consent_basis,p.eligible,m.status from memberships m join prospect_health p on p.id=m.prospect_id where m.campaign_id=$1 order by p.name

name: handoff-brief
title: Sales handoff brief
for_each: select id,prospect as name from handoff_queue order by due_on

name: consent-sheet
title: Prospect consent review
for_each: select id,name from prospects order by name

sections.title: Recorded changes
sections.sql: select action,evidence,actor,created_at from consent_events where prospect_id=$1 order by created_at
